question: Which of the following is a scheme of Government of India that provides financial assistance to the elderly, widows and persons with disabilities in the form of social pension?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Social Assistance Programme**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) is a government of Indi**a scheme that provides financial assistance to the elderly, widows, and people with disabilities.
 
• The scheme** is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.**
 
• NSAP provides** financial assistance ranging from Rs. 200 to Rs. 500 per month**
 
• **In the case of the death of the breadwinner, a lumpsum assistance of Rs. 20,000** is given to the bereaved family​
